name: Larch Valley and Sentinel Pass
why: From Moraine Lake up to a valley of larches that turn gold in mid-September under the Ten Peaks, and on to a pass at 2,611 m.
book: No cars on Moraine Lake Road: Parks Canada shuttle (reserve on reservation.pc.gc.ca) or a commercial bus. Group-of-four rule when bears are about: check the trail bulletins.
dangers: Grizzly bears: Parks Canada may require groups of four.
Snow and ice on Sentinel Pass until July and again from late September.
Loose scree on the last switchbacks.

points.name: Moraine Lake
points.note: The lake under the Ten Peaks, by the lodge.

points.name: Larch Valley
points.note: Meadows and larches with the Ten Peaks across the valley.
